question: Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp adds one extra +1/+1 counter whenever a modular triggered ability puts counters on a creature I control. Does it add one to the counters from its own modular ability?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the replacement effect needs Zabaz on the battlefield, so it does not increase its own modular counters.
expected.answer: Zabaz the Glimmerwasp's replacement effect requires it to be on the battlefield to work. Notably, that means it won't increase the counters given by its own modular ability.
